description: LIV-58 Island 1 quest chain. Pure data for the engine/quest-system.js dispatch tables: objective `type` values are talk|kill|fetch|reach|interact; reward `type` values are xp|gold|item|unlock_tower|set_flag. `vocationItems` is a data-only selector on an `item` reward: the reward handler grants the map entry for the active member's vocation (fallback `itemId`), so one quest hands each vocation its starter weapon without a per-quest branch. Quests chain by `prerequisites`; turn-ins are idempotent (a turned_in quest replays flavor only). The optional `onAccept` array (LIV-64) runs once on the inactive -> active transition: its `type` values are app-dispatched effects (currently `fate_grant`), so arming a player on accept is a catalog entry, never a per-quest JS branch.

quests.name: Rats in the Gutter
quests.summary: Captain Halden wants the town apron cleared of drowned crawlers, and their crowned leader put down.
quests.teaching: Movement, basic attack, ability use, potion sustain, and the knockout/auto-revive rule. The Gutter King is the first telegraphed charge: dodge the wind-up, punish the recovery.

quests.name: The Lantern Wreck
quests.summary: Wick the Lamplighter needs the beacon's cracked lens recovered from the Wreck of the Lantern on the west shore.
quests.teaching: Overworld exploration and the fetch loop; ranged/zoner threat reads (Tide Thralls hold a ring and slow), and the shop/temple sustain loop.

quests.name: Rite of the Beacon
quests.summary: Elder Rowan Vane will name the Pilgrim Keeper of the Tide, but only after the beacon is kindled at the Drowned Shrine.

levelGuard.note: Teaching guard only: Q1/Q2 already grant Levels 2/3, so reaching L3 is a consequence of the chain, never a separate grind. The real gate is the tower accessGate.

quests.teaching: Elite prioritization and telegraph/AoE reading, plus objective chaining (reach, interact, kill) alongside the diegetic Tide Gate.
